scope_en: Primary-source verification for topic selection, existing methods, model boundaries and public trace provenance. This register contains no project performance results.
scope_zh: 用于选题、已有方法、模型边界及公开轨迹来源的一手资料核查；本登记不包含项目性能结果。

sources.title: The KV Cache Working Set: Online Capacity Planning for LLM Inference Systems
sources.relevance_en: This-week evidence for KV-cache capacity planning; prior application of Mattson/Fenwick analysis to prefix reuse. PrefixScope does not claim this idea or its production results as its own.
sources.relevance_zh: 本周 KV 缓存容量规划新工作的证据；已有将 Mattson/Fenwick 分析用于前缀复用的方法。PrefixScope 不将该思路及生产实验结果归为自身贡献。

sources.title: KV Cache Capacity Estimator
sources.relevance_en: Existing implementation establishes originality boundaries, including consecutive-prefix metrics. No upstream code is bundled and no unmeasured performance comparison against it is claimed.
sources.relevance_zh: 已有实现界定原创性边界，包括连续前缀指标。未打包上游代码，也不声称未经测量的对比性能。

sources.title: H-Spec: Parallel Speculative Decoding Without a Drafter-Side KV Cache
sources.relevance_en: Current speculative-decoding candidate; not selected because faithful local evaluation would need trained draft/target models.
sources.relevance_zh: 近期投机解码候选；忠实本地评估需要训练好的 draft/target 模型，故未选。

sources.title: Train Where the Quantized Model Goes: On-Policy Distillation for Low-Bit Reasoning
sources.relevance_en: Current low-bit candidate; teacher/student training and reasoning evaluation exceed this experiment scope.
sources.relevance_zh: 近期低比特候选；teacher/student 训练及推理能力评测超出本实验范围。

sources.title: Evaluation Techniques for Storage Hierarchies
sources.relevance_en: Historical attribution for stack-based all-capacity cache analysis; not a PrefixScope invention.
sources.relevance_zh: 基于栈的全部容量缓存分析之历史归属，并非 PrefixScope 发明。

sources.title: A New Data Structure for Cumulative Frequency Tables
sources.relevance_en: Attribution for the binary indexed tree used for cumulative occupied-position counts.
sources.relevance_zh: 用于占用位置累积计数的树状数组之归属。

sources.title: Automatic Prefix Caching
sources.relevance_en: Full-block and chained-identity context; pinning, output allocation and reverse release show why this serial model is not an exact vLLM predictor.
sources.relevance_zh: 完整块和链式身份的背景；固定页、输出分配及逆序释放表明顺序模型并非 vLLM 精确预测器。

sources.title: Qwen-Bailian Anonymous Dataset
sources.relevance_en: Public production-derived anonymized content-block traces. PrefixScope selects first N records in file order and excludes incomplete input blocks; no production deployment is reproduced.
sources.relevance_zh: 公开的生产来源匿名内容块轨迹。PrefixScope 按文件顺序取前 N 条并排除不完整输入块；未复现生产部署。

sources.title: Q&A: Context Growth Pattern in Traces
sources.relevance_en: Explains special-token changes across turns and last-block padding updates; motivates complete-input-block filtering.
sources.relevance_zh: 解释跨轮特殊 token 变化与末块 padding 更新，支持仅保留完整输入块的处理。
